_about: The ONE place that says which Raptor version the pages show. The DOWNLOAD LINKS no longer carry a version: they are the stable addresses /windows and /mac on the Cloudflare Worker 'raptor-download' (source: release-proxy/worker.js in the desktop repo), which send people to the newest installer published in the raptor-dist GitHub releases, so a link can never point at an old version and a release needs no link edit. The Worker's /version answers with the newest versions as JSON: the download window (ventures/raptor/download.js) reads it, so even its version label is always current. Since 0.1.18 the pages fill their version words in by themselves: ventures/raptor/release.js asks /version when a page loads and updates every [data-raptor-version] marker, so publishing a release needs NO page edit and NO commit. The numbers below are only the fallback (what a browser without scripts, a search engine, or an unreachable server sees, and the FAQ text inside the page's structured data). To refresh that fallback at your leisure: change them, then run  python scripts/set_release.py  and commit.
